Class VisualTheme

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.CLI.VisualTheme
public class VisualTheme extends Object
Centralized theme manager that loads and provides visual assets for the CLI. It reads configuration data from a JSON file to decouple the visual style (colors, icons, symbols) from the application logic.
